games.desc:
Eclipsis is in alpha, expect bugs and incomplete features.
Private servers let you customize all kinds of match settings and play unrated matches.

A few hundred light-years away from Earth is the world of Eclipsis. Here, you are a mercenary fighting to secure supplies of Iridium for a mega corporation that hired you. games.name: Area 47: Roleplay
games.desc:
SCP - Area 47: Roleplay Welcome to Armed SCP Containment Area 47, a Role-Playing game for all things SCP!

This game is based on the SCP genre, and is a facility containing the most dangerous SCPs. The SCP Foundation is a multi-government collaboration to protect humanity. Contained in the facility are SCP Creatures of horror, SCP Monsters that could destroy the world if they ever escape. 

In this SCP Site Roleplay, you can play as all kinds of roles like Class - D, Scientist, Mobile Task Force, Security Department, and many more! Through playing these various roles, level up your keycard clearance in the Foundation, and assist in creating the most secure SCP Facility to exist.

games.name: [EASTER🐰] Obby King Remastered
games.desc:
Obby King is a fast-paced obstacle course game built for players who enjoy competitive challenges and exciting gameplay. Race through 100+ unique obbies, beat the clock, and compete against other players in a single continuous tournament experience.

There are rounds. Whether you’re new to Obby King or an experienced obby player, the game is easy to pick up and challenging to master.

Stay focused. Move fast. Claim the crown.

Features
- Round-style gameplay - compete from start to finish
- Time-based challenges - speed and accuracy matter
- Progress-based competition - keep up to stay in the action
- 100+ obby maps with increasing difficulty
- Earn coins and customise your character
- Leaderboards - track progress and show your skills

Invite your friends, enter the tournament, and see who rises to the top.
